title: Malicious code in t10-xor-spawn-testmetest (npm)
description: The npm package 't10-xor-spawn-testmetest' version 1.0.0 contains malicious code that decrypts and executes an opaque payload using a non-Node runtime called 'bun'. This behavior occurs on import, bypassing typical Node.js inspection methods. The payload is encrypted and dynamically executed, with its contents and behavior controlled by the author and not visible to the installer.
